caption: The drawing shows a single ceramic jar centered within a rectangular border on an off-white or light tan background. The jar is predominantly a warm beige color, with blue decorative designs painted on its surface. The jar has a wide rim and a slightly narrowing neck, flaring out again towards the middle before tapering somewhat at the base. There are two dark blue horizontal bands, one below the rim and another around the widest part of the jar. Between these bands, there is a scalloped decorative border, a stylized flower, a bird standing on a branch, and a rooster, as well as a branch with leaves and flowers. The jar appears to cast a subtle shadow onto the surface below. The artist’s name “John Dana” is written in small letters in the lower right corner within the rectangle.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
